coverage.note: Every entry is a real, dated match with an opponent, a competition and a score. The international list is RSSSF's appearance list (146 goals in 234 caps, the authoritative figures); the club list is the open CR7-Goals-Project export completed with the live goal tracker. Goals whose minute is not published are recorded with an empty minute list rather than an invented one, and the calendar is a lower bound on Ronaldo's scored days.
